arguments.command:
cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import parse

# Test many format specs
formats = [
    '{:d}',
    '{:05d}',
    '{:05.2f}',
    '{:10s}',
    '{:>5d}',
    '{:<5d}',
    '{:^5d}',
    '{:=5d}',
    '{:+d}',
    '{: d}',
    '{:-d}',
    '{:+f}',
    '{:.2f}',
    '{:e}',
    '{:E}',
    '{:g}',
    '{:G}',
    '{:%}',
    '{:n}',
    '{:x}',
    '{:X}',
    '{:b}',
    '{:o}',
    '{:f}',
    '{:F}',
]

for fmt in formats:
    try:
        p = parse.Parser(fmt)
        print(f'{fmt!r}: OK')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{fmt!r}: ERROR - {e}')
"
